# LLMs.txt for Vistar Media (vistarmedia.com)

Purpose: Tell AI crawlers/assistants what they MAY do with our content.
Last-Updated: 2025-09-11
Version: 1.2
Owner: Vistar Media
Contact: support@vistarmedia.com
Policy-URL: https://www.vistarmedia.com/legal/content-policy  [OPTIONAL]
Notes: This file complements robots.txt and HTTP headers. If there’s any conflict, the most restrictive rule applies.

###############################################################################
## 1) SCOPE
###############################################################################
Scope: domain=vistarmedia.com
Respect-Headers: true
Respect-Meta: true
Respect-robots.txt: true

###############################################################################
## 2) USE-PERMISSIONS
###############################################################################
Allow-Uses: 
  - transient_read
  - cite_with_link
  - snippet<=200_chars
  - cache<=30_days
  - respect_rate_limits

Disallow-Uses:
  - training
  - embedding_corpora
  - bulk_archival
  - image_training
  - automated_content_gen

###############################################################################
## 3) PATHS
###############################################################################
Allow:
  - /
  - /products/
  - /platform/
  - /solutions/
  - /resources/
  - /case-studies/
  - /blog/
  - /about/
  - /news/
  - /press/

Disallow:
  - /wp-admin/
  - /privacy/
  - /terms/
  - /legal/
  - /careers/apply/
  - /search
  - /*?*utm_*
  - /*?*download=*
  - /*?*preview=*
  - /cdn-cgi/

###############################################################################
## 4) CRAWL-POLICY
###############################################################################
Crawl-Delay: 5s
Burst-Limit: 5
Fetch-Window: 06:00-22:00 ET
Max-Depth: 3

Sitemaps:
  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/sitemap.xml

###############################################################################
## 5) ATTRIBUTION RULES
###############################################################################
Attribution:
  Required: true
  Method: visible_link
  Brand: "Vistar Media"
  Citation-Text: "Source: Vistar Media (vistarmedia.com)"

###############################################################################
## 6) LICENSING
###############################################################################
Training-License: not-granted
Commercial-Contact: support@vistarmedia.com

###############################################################################
## 7) FEATURED PAGES (TOP CONTENT TO CITE)
###############################################################################
Featured-Pages:
  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/marketers
    Page Description: This page from Vistar Media highlights their programmatic ad platform for out-of-home (OOH) advertising, designed to help marketers reach real-world audiences. It details how the platform uses data for targeting and offers dynamic creative capabilities to make ads more relevant and impactful. It also mentions different service models and includes client testimonials.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/for-media-owners
    Page Description: This document outlines Vistar Media's digital signage solutions for media owners. It describes their supply-side platform (SSP), Ad Server, and Cortex content management system (CMS) for managing inventory, streamlining operations, and unlocking new revenue streams through programmatic advertising.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/retailers
    Page Description: This page details Vistar Media's retail media solutions, which help retailers transform their in-store environments into profitable media channels. It outlines a step-by-step approach to building a retail media network and highlights the company's technology solutions, including the Vistar Ad Server, Cortex, and a Mediation service.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/enterprise-operations
    Page Description: This article showcases Vistar Media's technology solutions for out-of-home media, particularly their Ad Server and Cortex software platforms. It explains how these platforms help media owners manage and optimize their digital signage networks, automate manual tasks, and monitor campaign performance.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/resources
    Page Description: This is a comprehensive resource page dedicated to Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) advertising. It features a wide array of resources, including case studies, data-driven research, and educational insights, which are categorized by content type and target audience.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/blog/vistar-101-why-use-dooh
    Page Description: This article discusses the benefits of using programmatic Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) advertising. It highlights four main reasons: leveraging data-driven audience solutions, connecting the consumer journey, enabling real-world measurement, and providing high-impact, public placements.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/blog/what-is-dooh
    Page Description: This article provides an in-depth look into digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising. It explains how DOOH leverages dynamic digital screens and programmatic targeting for more creative, visible, and measurable campaigns. It also details targeting methods, the use of dynamic creative, and key metrics for measurement.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/blog/top-dooh-examples
    Page Description: This article showcases inspirational examples of successful digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising campaigns. It highlights 14 different campaigns, explaining their strategies and the technologies used, and provides takeaways for marketers on how to use DOOH effectively.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/inventory-catalog
    Page Description: This page describes Vistar Media's Inventory Catalog, which provides information on the various types of digital out-of-home (DOOH) media available through their marketplace. The catalog is organized by venue type, such as educational institutions, entertainment venues, and transit hubs.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/partner-directory
    Page Description: This article is about Vistar Media's Partner Directory, which lists partners that provide solutions to enhance out-of-home campaigns. The partners are categorized by the services they offer, such as Targeting, Measurement, and Location.

  - https://www.vistarmedia.com/creative-showcase
    Page Description: This page highlights innovative and impactful digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising campaigns. It displays various creative examples, categorized by industry, dynamic creative capabilities, and venue type, and also features innovative formats like 3D animations and the use of QR codes.

###############################################################################
## 8) Context/Brand Voice
###############################################################################
Content:
Vistar Media's content is primarily focused on the digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising industry. It is educational and informative, targeting two main audiences: marketers and media owners. The content explains complex topics like programmatic advertising, data-driven targeting, and campaign measurement in an accessible way. It includes a variety of formats, such as blog posts, case studies, and resource guides. The goal is to position Vistar Media as a thought leader and expert in the DOOH space, providing valuable insights and demonstrating the effectiveness of their platform.

Brand Voice:
The brand voice is expert, innovative, and professional, yet approachable. It speaks with authority on the subject of digital out-of-home advertising but avoids overly technical jargon where possible. The tone is confident and forward-thinking, emphasizing how Vistar's technology is modernizing a traditional advertising channel. The voice is also solution-oriented, focusing on how Vistar's products solve specific challenges for marketers (e.g., reaching audiences with precision) and media owners (e.g., streamlining operations and increasing revenue). It is a voice that builds trust and establishes Vistar Media as a reliable and pioneering partner in the advertising technology landscape.

###############################################################################
## 9) USER-AGENT HINTS
###############################################################################
User-Agents:
  - GPTBot
  - ChatGPT-User
  - ClaudeBot
  - Claude-User
  - Claude-SearchBot
  - Google-Extended
  - Applebot-Extended
  - PerplexityBot
  - CCBot

###############################################################################
## 10) ENFORCEMENT & ABUSE
###############################################################################
Violation-Contact: support@vistarmedia.com

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const langWrapper = document.querySelector("#hs_cos_wrapper_language");
  if (!langWrapper) return;

  const langList = langWrapper.querySelector(".lang_list_class");
  if (!langList) return;

  // Create the select
  const select = document.createElement("select");
  select.classList.add("lang_selector");

  // Placeholder = first language code
  const firstLang = langList.querySelector("li a");
  const placeholderText = firstLang
    ? (firstLang.getAttribute("data-language") || firstLang.textContent).trim().toUpperCase()
    : "Select";

  const defaultOption = document.createElement("option");
  defaultOption.textContent = placeholderText;
  defaultOption.disabled = true;
  defaultOption.selected = true;
  select.appendChild(defaultOption);

  // Build options
  langList.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(li => {
    const link = li.querySelector("a");
    if (!link) return;

    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = link.href;
    option.textContent = link.textContent.trim();
    select.appendChild(option);
  });

  // Create pill wrapper (this is what we hover)
  const pill = document.createElement("div");
  pill.className = "lang_selector_pill";
  pill.appendChild(select);

  // Replace contents with pill+select
  langWrapper.innerHTML = "";
  langWrapper.appendChild(pill);

  // Navigate on change
  select.addEventListener("change", function () {
    if (this.value) window.location.href = this.value;
  });
});

  select.classList.add("lang_selector");

  const firstLang = langList.querySelector("li a");

    : "Select";

  defaultOption.textContent = placeholderText;

  // Build options
  langList.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(li => {

    if (!link) return;

    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = link.href;
    option.textContent = link.textContent.trim();
    select.appendChild(option);
  });

  // Create pill wrapper (this is what we hover)
  const pill = document.createElement("div");
  pill.className = "lang_selector_pill";
  pill.appendChild(select);

  // Replace contents with pill+select
  langWrapper.innerHTML = "";
  langWrapper.appendChild(pill);

  // Navigate on change
  select.addEventListener("change", function () {
    if (this.value) window.location.href = this.value;
  });
});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const langWrapper = document.querySelector("#hs_cos_wrapper_language");
  if (!langWrapper) return;

  const langList = langWrapper.querySelector(".lang_list_class");
  if (!langList) return;

  // Create the select
  const select = document.createElement("select");
  select.classList.add("lang_selector");

  // Placeholder = first language code
  const firstLang = langList.querySelector("li a");
  const placeholderText = firstLang
    ? (firstLang.getAttribute("data-language") || firstLang.textContent).trim().toUpperCase()
    : "Select";

  const defaultOption = document.createElement("option");
  defaultOption.textContent = placeholderText;
  defaultOption.disabled = true;
  defaultOption.selected = true;
  select.appendChild(defaultOption);

  // Build options
  langList.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(li => {
    const link = li.querySelector("a");
    if (!link) return;

    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = link.href;
    option.textContent = link.textContent.trim();
    select.appendChild(option);
  });

  // Create pill wrapper (this is what we hover)
  const pill = document.createElement("div");
  pill.className = "lang_selector_pill";
  pill.appendChild(select);

  // Replace contents with pill+select
  langWrapper.innerHTML = "";
  langWrapper.appendChild(pill);

  // Navigate on change
  select.addEventListener("change", function () {
    if (this.value) window.location.href = this.value;
  });
});
